name: Reader Rabbit: I Can Read With Phonics
summary: Reader Rabbit: I Can Read With Phonics (stylized as Reader Rabbit: I Can Read! With Phonics) is a 2-in-1 CD compilation released in 2000 by The Learning Company. The compilation features the games Reader Rabbit Reading Adventures Ages 6–9 (titled "Road to Imagination") and Reader Rabbit's Reading 2 (titled "Wordville Station").
